title: Apple Dictation vs MacWhisper on Mac: choosing the right voice tool
description: Compare Apple Dictation vs MacWhisper to see which Mac voice tool fits your workflow. Explore features, privacy, and costs for your daily tasks.
intro: Apple Dictation is a free, system-level feature for quick text input, while MacWhisper is a specialized app for transcribing audio files and meetings. Choosing between them depends on whether you need a fast way to type emails or a robust tool for processing recorded audio.
tldr: Use Apple Dictation for quick, short bursts of text in any app.
Use MacWhisper for transcribing long audio files, meetings, or complex recordings.
Use Lazur for an all-in-one assistant that handles research, screen guidance, and dictation.
Apple Dictation is free and built-in; MacWhisper is a one-time purchase.

blocks.text: Apple Dictation lives inside your macOS system. You trigger it with a keyboard shortcut or via the Edit menu. It works in almost any text field, from Mail to Notes. It is ideal for short messages or quick thoughts. On Apple Silicon Macs, it processes your voice locally, so your data stays on your machine. However, it stops after 30 seconds of silence. It also lacks a custom dictionary for specialized jargon.

MacWhisper focuses on transcription rather than just live typing. You drag and drop audio or video files into the app, and it turns them into text. It supports over 100 languages and provides exports in formats like SRT, VTT, and Markdown. The Pro version adds batch processing and speaker recognition. It is a powerful tool for journalists, researchers, or anyone who records meetings.

The main difference is the intended use case. Apple Dictation is a utility for real-time writing. MacWhisper is a production tool for media files. You might use Apple Dictation to type a quick Slack message, but you would use MacWhisper to transcribe a one-hour recorded interview. MacWhisper allows you to work with files that already exist, whereas Apple Dictation requires you to speak as you write.

blocks.caption: A comparison of capabilities across the three tools.

blocks.text: If you need a free, always-available way to type short notes, Apple Dictation is the correct choice. It is already on your Mac and requires no extra setup. If your work involves transcribing long audio files or meetings, MacWhisper provides the depth and features you need. If you want a tool that helps you navigate your screen, answer questions, and dictate text, consider Lazur.

faq.question: Is Apple Dictation free?
faq.answer: Yes, Apple Dictation is built into macOS and is free to use.

faq.question: Does MacWhisper work offline?
faq.answer: Yes, MacWhisper performs all transcription locally on your device to ensure privacy.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur for dictation?
faq.answer: Yes, Lazur includes dictation as part of its feature set, along with screen guidance and research capabilities.
